task.description:
Design test specifications for DSL-06 — Total evaluation.

Write test spec file at tests/specs/DSL-06.md covering the DSL-06 requirement:

Acceptance criteria from requirements:
1. A property-based test generates random valid-grammar expressions; all evaluate within a fixed step bound.
2. No expression evaluation results in a host crash or panic.

The BACKEND-DEV implementation (Step 02) already added property-based tests inside src/expr/mod.zig. Your job is to:
1. Verify the existing tests cover all acceptance criteria
2. Write the formal test spec at tests/specs/DSL-06.md
3. Identify any gaps: are the existing property-based tests sufficient? Are there edge cases not covered?

The existing tests in mod.zig include:
- MAX_EVAL_DEPTH constant existence
- evaluate delegates to evaluateNode with max depth
- evaluateNode with remaining=1 evaluates leaf nodes but fails on binary
- Deep chain hits depth limit (2048-depth chain)
- 100 random expressions evaluate within bound (seeded PRNG, all 14 Node variants)

Your test spec should:
- List all test cases with IDs (T1, T2, ...), descriptions, expected outcomes
- Include edge cases: depth boundary at exactly MAX_EVAL_DEPTH, depth exceeded at MAX_EVAL_DEPTH+1
- Include property-based test specification (number of expressions, coverage requirements)
- Map each acceptance criterion to specific test cases

Do not write test code — write the specification.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec file written to tests/specs/DSL-06.md
All acceptance criteria mapped to test cases
Edge cases documented (depth boundary, all Node variants)
Property-based test specification complete (seed, count, coverage)

result.summary: Test spec written for DSL-06 — Total evaluation. Test spec at tests/specs/DSL-06.md documents 10 test cases (TC-DSL-06-01 through TC-DSL-06-10), maps both acceptance criteria to test cases, covers edge cases (depth boundary, all 14 Node variants), and includes property-based test specification. Identified 4 minor gaps in existing inline tests (exact depth boundaries at MAX_EVAL_DEPTH and MAX_EVAL_DEPTH+1, unary node at remaining=1, variant coverage assertion) — none are blocking for acceptance criteria satisfaction.

issues.description: No test for a chain of exactly MAX_EVAL_DEPTH (1024) that should succeed — TC-DSL-06-05 documented as gap
No test for a chain of exactly MAX_EVAL_DEPTH+1 (1025) that should fail at the depth guard — TC-DSL-06-06 documented as gap
No explicit test for unary operator (neg/not) with remaining=1 — TC-DSL-06-09 documented as gap
